newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Kleinwort Benson recommended for Tatneft Eurobond. [CORRECTED 14:29 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Kleinwort Benson recommended for Tatneft Eurobond. [CORRECTED 14:29 GMT]

text.p: (Finance Ministry in Tatarstan corrects borrower in headline and text to AO Tatneft.)

Russia's Tatarstan republic has recommended London investment bank Dresdner Kleinwort Benson as Eurobond underwriter for oil company AO Tatneft, a Tatarstan Finance Ministry official said on Thursday (corrects to show Kleinwort has been recommended as underwriter not named as such).

"The cabinet of ministers regulation says the underwriter for our Eurobond issue will be Dresdner Kleinwort Benson," the head of the ministry's securities department Konstantin Kolesnik, told Reuters, referring to Tatneft.
He said the cabinet had recommended Kleinwort.
Tatneft plans to issue a Eurobond no earlier than the second half of this year.

Last July Tatneft issued level-one American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) share proxies that trade abroad and are backed by domestic stocks. In December it placed ADRs covering 10 percent of its authorised capital among insitutional investors.
It is considering issuing level-three ADRs, which allow capital raising, in 1997.

The Tatarstan republic, a major shareholder in Tatneft, is also planning to issue a Eurobond in its own right. Officials had previously said the issue could take place this summer, but Kolesnik said early next year was now more realistic.
